newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Electronic Data Systems.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Electronic Data Systems.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its 1997 earnings estimate on Electronic Data Systems Corp to $2.40 a share from $2.35 a share.
-- Said "flurry of outsourcing megacontracts are expected in the coming weeks."
-- Expects management to make a 1997 earnings forecast when it releases quarterly results on Feb 6. Expects management to forecast 13-15 percent growth for 1997.
-- Set 12-month price target of $63 a share.
-- Said earnings pressure seen in fourth quarter will ease in the first quarter of 1997.
-- Shares gained 2-7/8 to 48-3/8 in afternoon trade.
